command: export LAB="$EDGE_LAB"
umask 077
mkdir -m 700 "$LAB"
export SRC="$EDGE_SOURCE"
export GW_IMAGE="$EDGE_GATEWAY_IMAGE"
docker image inspect "$GW_IMAGE" --format "{{.Id}}" > "$LAB/image-id.txt"
docker ps -a --filter label=owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}}"
! docker network inspect uc7-security > /dev/null 2>&1
mkdir -m 700 "$LAB/config"
openssl rand -hex 24 > "$LAB/config/pg_password"
openssl rand -hex 24 > "$LAB/config/aikey_password"
openssl rand -hex 24 > "$LAB/config/mgmt_db_password"
docker network create --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --subnet 172.30.97.0/24 uc7-security

mkdir -m 700 "$LAB/pgdata" && docker run -d --name uc7-pg -v "$LAB/pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data" --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --network uc7-security --ip 172.30.97.30 -v "$LAB/config:/run/uc7:ro" -e POSTGRES_USER=uc7owner -e POSTGRES_DB=uc7 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/uc7/pg_password "$PG_IMAGE"
sleep 8
docker exec uc7-pg pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U uc7owner -d uc7
docker cp "$SRC/scripts/aigw-db-bootstrap.sql" uc7-pg:/tmp/bootstrap.sql
docker exec uc7-pg sh -c 'AIGW_DB_PASSWORD=$(cat /run/uc7/aikey_password) AIGW_MGMT_DB_PASSWORD=$(cat /run/uc7/mgmt_db_password) psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U uc7owner -d uc7 -q -f /tmp/bootstrap.sql'

docker run -d --name uc7-gw --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --privileged --network uc7-security --ip 172.30.97.10 -v "$LAB/config:/etc/loxilb" -e LOXILB_KV_COLDSTART_SEED_N=0 -e LLB_KV_NONE_HASH_SEED=0 -e LLB_PD_MAX_TOTAL_INFLIGHT=16 --entrypoint /bin/bash "$GW_IMAGE" -c "sleep infinity"
docker run -d --name uc7-a --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --network uc7-security --ip 172.30.97.50 --entrypoint /bin/bash "$CLIENT_IMAGE" -c "sleep infinity"
docker run -d --name uc7-b --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --network uc7-security --ip 172.30.97.51 --entrypoint /bin/bash "$CLIENT_IMAGE" -c "sleep infinity"
docker run -d --name uc7-c --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --network uc7-security --ip 172.30.97.52 --entrypoint /bin/bash "$CLIENT_IMAGE" -c "sleep infinity"
docker run -d --name uc7-d --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --network uc7-security --ip 172.30.97.53 --entrypoint /bin/bash "$CLIENT_IMAGE" -c "sleep infinity"
docker run -d --name uc7-ep --label owner="$EDGE_OWNER" --network uc7-security --ip 172.30.97.21 -e ECHO_NAME=uc7-backend "$BACKEND_IMAGE"

docker exec -d uc7-gw bash -c '/root/loxilb-io/loxilb/loxilb -p --userservice --mgmt-db-host 172.30.97.30 --mgmt-db-port 5432 --mgmt-db-user aigw_mgmt_user --mgmt-db-name uc7 --mgmt-db-password-file /etc/loxilb/mgmt_db_password --aikey-db-host 172.30.97.30 --aikey-db-port 5432 --aikey-db-user aigwuser --aikey-db-name uc7 --aikey-db-password-file /etc/loxilb/aikey_password > /tmp/uc7.out 2>/tmp/uc7.err'
sleep 15
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/version"
jq -n --arg password "$EDGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD" '{username:"uc7admin",password:$password,role:"admin"}' > "$LAB/admin.json"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/admin.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/auth/users"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/admin.json")" http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/auth/login > "$LAB/login.private.json"
export TOKEN=$(jq -er .token "$LAB/login.private.json")
docker exec uc7-gw mkdir -p /etc/loxilb/tokenizers/Qwen__Qwen3-0.6B
docker cp "$SRC/cicd/common/kv_hash/fixtures/tokenizers/Qwen__Qwen3-0.6B/tokenizer.json" uc7-gw:/etc/loxilb/tokenizers/Qwen__Qwen3-0.6B/tokenizer.json
docker cp "$SRC/cicd/common/kv_hash/fixtures/kv_hash_vectors.json" uc7-gw:/etc/loxilb/tokenizers/kv_hash_vectors.json
jq "[.prompts[0] | {prompt:.prompt}]" "$SRC/cicd/vllm-kvcache-routing-cpu/prompts/corpus.json" > "$LAB/corpus.json"
jq '.prompts[0] | {model:"Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B",prompt:.prompt,max_tokens:8}' "$SRC/cicd/vllm-kvcache-routing-cpu/prompts/corpus.json" > "$LAB/request.json"

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/alias.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/loadbalancer"

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/model.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/loadbalancer"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/loadbalancer/all"
jq '.allowedSources=[{prefix:"172.30.97.51/32"}]' "$LAB/model.json" > "$LAB/conflict.json"

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/conflict.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/loadbalancer"

cat > "$LAB/blacklist.json" <<'JSON'
{
  "filterType": "blacklist",
  "cidr": "172.30.97.51/32",
  "action": "drop",
  "priority": 210
}
JSON

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/blacklist.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/ipfilter"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/ipfilter/all"

docker exec uc7-b curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: XDP-04" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions

python3 "$SRC/cicd/edge-cloud-security/wait_metric.py" loxilb_ipfilter_blacklist_packets_total &&
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/metrics" > "$LAB/xdp.prom"

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/ipfilter?filterType=blacklist&cidr=172.30.97.51/32"

cat > "$LAB/securityrate.json" <<'JSON'
{
  "synEnabled": true,
  "synThreshold": 10,
  "cookieThreshold": 5,
  "connRateEnabled": true,
  "ratePerSec": 5,
  "udpEnabled": true,
  "udpPktThreshold": 100,
  "udpBandwidthMB": 100
}
JSON

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/securityrate.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/securityrate"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/securityrate/all"

docker exec uc7-c curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/models > "$LAB/rate-0.txt" 2>&1 &
RATE_PID_1=$!

docker exec uc7-c curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/models > "$LAB/rate-1.txt" 2>&1 &
RATE_PID_2=$!

docker exec uc7-c curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/models > "$LAB/rate-2.txt" 2>&1 &
RATE_PID_3=$!

docker exec uc7-c curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/models > "$LAB/rate-3.txt" 2>&1 &
RATE_PID_4=$!

docker exec uc7-c curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/models > "$LAB/rate-4.txt" 2>&1 &
RATE_PID_5=$!

docker exec uc7-c curl -sS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/models > "$LAB/rate-5.txt" 2>&1 &
RATE_PID_6=$!
wait "$RATE_PID_1" "$RATE_PID_2" "$RATE_PID_3" "$RATE_PID_4" "$RATE_PID_5" "$RATE_PID_6"
sleep 12
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/metrics" > "$LAB/rate.prom"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/securityrate"

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/firewall.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/firewall"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/firewall/all"

docker exec uc7-d curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: FW-04" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions

python3 "$SRC/cicd/edge-cloud-security/wait_metric.py" loxilb_fw_rule_drop_packets_total &&
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/metrics" > "$LAB/firewall.prom"

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/firewall?sourceIP=172.30.97.53/32&destinationIP=172.30.97.10/32&minDestinationPort=8080&maxDestinationPort=8080&protocol=6&preference=65010"

docker exec uc7-a bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/172.30.97.10/8080; printf "POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 172.30.97.10:8080\r\n" >&3; sleep 8' > "$LAB/holder-0.txt" 2>&1 &
HOLDER_PID_1=$!

docker exec uc7-a bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/172.30.97.10/8080; printf "POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 172.30.97.10:8080\r\n" >&3; sleep 8' > "$LAB/holder-1.txt" 2>&1 &
HOLDER_PID_2=$!

docker exec uc7-a bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/172.30.97.10/8080; printf "POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 172.30.97.10:8080\r\n" >&3; sleep 8' > "$LAB/holder-2.txt" 2>&1 &
HOLDER_PID_3=$!

docker exec uc7-a bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/172.30.97.10/8080; printf "POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 172.30.97.10:8080\r\n" >&3; sleep 8' > "$LAB/holder-3.txt" 2>&1 &
HOLDER_PID_4=$!
sleep 2
docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 3 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/models
wait "$HOLDER_PID_1" "$HOLDER_PID_2" "$HOLDER_PID_3" "$HOLDER_PID_4"
sleep 2

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/loadbalancer/externalipaddress/172.30.97.10/port/8080/protocol/tcp/stats"

cat > "$LAB/key-request.json" <<'JSON'
{
  "tenant_id": "uc7-tenant",
  "name": "uc7-key",
  "allowed_models": [
    "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B"
  ],
  "rate_limit_rps": 1,
  "burst_size": 1,
  "tokens_per_min": 100000,
  "enabled": true
}
JSON

docker exec uc7-gw curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/key-request.json")" http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/ai/apikey > "$LAB/key.private.json"
export RAW_KEY=$(jq -er .raw_key "$LAB/key.private.json")
export KEY_ID=$(jq -er .key_id "$LAB/key.private.json")
sleep 15

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: KEY-06" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: KEY-07" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions
sleep 2

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: ACL-08" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions

docker exec uc7-b curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: ACL-09" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions
sleep 2

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/burst-0.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_1=$!

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/burst-1.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_2=$!

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/burst-2.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_3=$!

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/burst-3.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_4=$!

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/burst-4.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_5=$!

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/burst-5.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_6=$!
wait "$KEY_PID_1" "$KEY_PID_2" "$KEY_PID_3" "$KEY_PID_4" "$KEY_PID_5" "$KEY_PID_6"
cat "$LAB"/burst-*.txt
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/metrics" > "$LAB/l7.prom"
sleep 2

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: KEY-19" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions
export EP_PID=$(docker inspect -f "{{.State.Pid}}" uc7-ep)

PYTHONPATH= PYTHONHASHSEED=0 nsenter -t "$EP_PID" -n "$EDGE_VENV/bin/python" "$SRC/cicd/vllm-kvcache-routing-cpu/kv_event_publisher.py" --corpus "$LAB/corpus.json" --tokenizer "$SRC/cicd/common/kv_hash/fixtures/tokenizers/Qwen__Qwen3-0.6B/tokenizer.json" --vectors "$SRC/cicd/common/kv_hash/fixtures/kv_hash_vectors.json" --bind 172.30.97.21 --port 5557 --algo sha256_cbor --block-size 16 --repeat 100 --repeat-interval 5 --no-vocabulary > "$LAB/publisher.log" 2>&1 &
export PUB_PID=$!

sleep 12
kill -0 "$PUB_PID"
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/metrics" > "$LAB/kv-before.prom"

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: KV-06" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions
sleep 12
docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/metrics" > "$LAB/kv-after.prom"
grep -E "tier15_hits|inventory|kv_" "$LAB/kv-after.prom"
nsenter -t "$EP_PID" -n tcpdump -l -i eth0 -A -s 0 "tcp port 80" > "$LAB/receipt.private.log" 2> "$LAB/capture.log" &
export CAP_PID=$!

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/blacklist.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/ipfilter"

docker exec uc7-gw curl -sS --max-time 10 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/securityrate.json")" "http://127.0.0.1:11111/netlox/v1/config/securityrate"

docker exec uc7-b curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: ALL-10" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions

docker exec uc7-d curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: ALL-11" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: ALL-12" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Edge-Nonce: ALL-14" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions
sleep 2

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/all-burst-0.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_1=$!

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/all-burst-1.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_2=$!

docker exec uc7-a curl -sS --max-time 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Api-Key: $RAW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(cat "$LAB/request.json")" http://172.30.97.10:8080/v1/completions > "$LAB/all-burst-2.txt" 2>&1 &
KEY_PID_3=$!
